description: This is a PHP unit test class for the JobCategoryService in the OrangeHRM system. It contains setup code and test methods for verifying the behavior of the service methods such as getJobCategoryList and getJobCategoryById.

classes.name: JobCategoryServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the JobCategoryService in the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It includes tests for fetching the list of job categories and fetching a job category by ID.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for each test, instantiates JobCategoryService and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetJobCategoryList
methods.description: Tests that getJobCategoryList returns the expected list of JobCategory objects.

methods.name: testGtJobCategoryById
methods.description: Tests that getJobCategoryById returns the correct JobCategory object for a given ID.
